objective: Run the E2E closure gate for seam S1 — two GETs for the same profile id, first hitting the store, second served from cache, with exactly one store call — and produce the gate evidence

frozen_contracts.spec: GET /profiles/{id} returns 200 {id, name} for a known id or 404 {error: {code: 'not_found'}} for an unknown id
Cache: get(key) -> value|None; set(key, value, ttl_seconds) -> None; 60s default TTL; in-memory only

non_goals: No production code changes — gate defects are reported with seam location, not fixed here
No new acceptance criteria — only A1/A2 mapped through gate E1
implementation_constraints: The store is a test double that counts calls; the cache must be the real module
Gate evidence records pass/fail + the call count + the output excerpt

acceptance_tests.description: two consecutive GETs for the same id both return 200 and the store double records exactly one call
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/e2e/test_profile_flow.py::test_read_through_cache asserts both responses are 200 and store.call_count == 1

acceptance_tests.description: if the second GET hits the store (read-through regression), the gate fails with the call count recorded as evidence
acceptance_tests.evidence: the same test fails with call_count == 2 recorded in the output excerpt

failure_cases.scenario: gate E1 fails while both unit suites are green
failure_cases.expected_behavior: record the failing gate + seam S1 + output in the checkpoint as a blocker; do not re-run the leaves

handoff.notes: Stage-closing checkpoint: remaining_dag empty, acceptance verdict in downstream_notes
